name: Multiple violations
expect: TERMINATED - TIME LIMIT with PROCESS_LIMIT + CPU_LIMIT
description: Hits the PID cap, then spins until the deadline: several violations in one run.

name: Forbidden syscall
description: Calls ptrace(); the seccomp filter kills it.

name: Fork bomb (unbounded)
description: A real fork bomb. The pids cgroup caps it; the watchdog ends it.
